name: Calvar'ion
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategies: attack styles that can damage the boss (generated by scripts/gen-bosses.mjs).
validationNotes: DPS against each phase is covered by the reference validation tests where the rules are modelled. Calvar'ion's skeletons and second form are not modelled (both forms share the same statistics). Strategies are the attack styles that can damage this boss, best-known first; they are not a strategy guide. Damage-taken weights for Survivability are derived from the attack styles listed for the boss, equally weighted.

requirements.text: Access requirements are not checked by the plugin: see the wiki page

warnings: This boss is in the Wilderness: other players can attack you there and items are at risk on death.
Wilderness weapons (Craw's bow, Viggora's chainmace, Thammaron's sceptre and their upgrades) are not modelled; setups using them are shown as estimates.
